summary: Configured and verified the routed Kubernetes cluster. All three Ubuntu nodes are Ready, LAN-based, and the cluster is configured for reboot persistence.
actions_performed: Configured node1 VyOS routing between both LANs with persistent forwarding and firewall state.
Configured persistent Ubuntu LAN addresses/routes while preserving management DHCP.
Installed and enabled containerd and Kubernetes v1.37.0 with persistent kubelet LAN node IPs.
Initialized node2 and joined node3/node4 to the same cluster.
Configured Flannel VXLAN over enp8s0; validated cross-LAN pod traffic, ClusterIP service access, and CoreDNS.
Removed temporary test workloads, logs, and bootstrap tokens.
